prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object. Check properties. Approach if visible, move to next location if not.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextLocation    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
